title: Reward-Weighted On-Policy Distillation with an Open Property-Equivalence Verifier for NL-to-SVA Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.13501v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Specialized language models for translating natural language (NL) into SystemVerilog assertions (SVA) reach approximately 76\% accuracy on NL2SVA-Human, but aggregate scores obscure errors on bounded-delay and liveness specifications. Models often reuse a small set of implication templates where different temporal behavior is required. Supervised fine-tuning rewards agreement with reference tokens, whereas SVA correctness depends on property equivalence. We propose \emph{reward-weighted on-policy distillation} (RWOPD), which uses an open SymbiYosys+Z3 property-equivalence checker to select student rollouts and weight their distillation loss. A frozen 14B teacher supplies forward Kullback--Leibler (KL) supervision at each response token; equivalent rollouts receive greater weight than one-sided implications. Starting from curriculum supervised fine-tuning (SFT), RWOPD distills CodeV-SVA-14B into a Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct stude

translated_title: 用于自然语言到SVA生成的带开放性质等价验证器的奖励加权在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 面向将自然语言（NL）转换为SystemVerilog断言（SVA）的专用语言模型在NL2SVA-Human基准上达到了约76%的准确率，但总体分数掩盖了模型在有界延迟和活性规范上的错误。在需要不同时序行为的情况下，模型往往复用一小组蕴含模板。监督微调奖励的是与参考标记的一致性，而SVA的正确性取决于性质等价性。我们提出了奖励加权在线策略蒸馏（RWOPD），该方法使用开放的SymbiYosys+Z3性质等价检查器来筛选学生模型的推理 rollout，并对其蒸馏损失进行加权。一个冻结的14B教师模型在每个响应标记处提供前向KL散度监督；性质等价的rollout比单侧蕴含获得更大的权重。从课程化监督微调（SFT）出发，RWOPD将CodeV-SVA-14B蒸馏到Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct学生模型中。
tldr: 该论文提出奖励加权在线策略蒸馏（RWOPD），利用开放的SymbiYosys+Z3性质等价验证器筛选并加权学生模型 rollout，使7B小模型在自然语言到SystemVerilog断言生成中学会真正性质等价的时序行为，而非机械复用蕴含模板。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes reward-weighted on-policy distillation (RWOPD), which uses an open SymbiYosys+Z3 property-equivalence checker to select and weight student rollouts, enabling a 7B model to generate truly property-equivalent SVAs instead of merely reusing implication templates.
